source: Owner direct chat rejecting the running ED-02 candidate and supplying a video reference
owner_message_original: Нет нет и нет, это абсолютно не то, что там надо, что за ровные слои у тебя выходят!!! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fyY5w8T444w посмотри видео в хроме пожалуйста,там показано разружение колон нормальное
owner_message_english_translation: No, no and no, this is absolutely not what is needed. Why are you producing these even layers? Please watch this video in Chrome; it shows proper column destruction.
decision: MSQ-142-Candidate01 is owner-rejected for its even, plate-like layered fracture geometry. Stop its execution and acceptance. Preserve its assets, editable sources and evidence. Continue the authorized ED-02 correction as MSQ-142-Candidate02, using the reference observations below.

reference.title: Shooter in Unreal Engine 5 - Chaos Destruction and Physical Casings Test #unrealengine #vfx
reference.inspection: Controller opened and viewed the video in Chrome, including playback and selected frames. Column observations concern approximately 00:26-00:37 and 00:47-01:07; earlier thin-panel shots are a different specimen.
observed_column_features: Concrete breaks away as varied, irregular three-dimensional chunks, with smaller chips accompanying larger pieces.
Damage leaves ragged boundaries, inclined rough fracture surfaces, uneven recess depths and a changed local silhouette, including near a corner.
Repeated local damage creates connected irregular cavities while adjacent unhit concrete remains intact.
Exposed reinforcement is visible in deeply damaged regions. Dust accompanies impacts, but the irregular concrete geometry remains visible after dust clears.
reference.limits: These are visual observations, not access to the video's implementation, exact dimensions, material parameters or fracture algorithm. Reinforcement is an observed reference feature; structural collapse or a new structural simulation is not authorized by it.

controller_diagnosis: The rejected generator repeats one two-dimensional face partition through matched depth strata. Slightly tilting planes and adding faceted cap tips does not remove the dominant plate/shell appearance. Exposure, texture and dust cannot correct that geometry.
correction_requirements: Replace the repeated aligned-depth partition with genuinely volumetric, spatially irregular concrete fracture. Material regions do not imply regularly peeled geometric strata.
Use varied chunk proportions, ragged multi-scale boundaries, uneven cavity depth and rough fracture interiors. Avoid repeated matching outlines, broad planar backing and orderly stacks of plates.

Create an early in-engine visual checkpoint: intact, first local concrete loss, repeated local loss and retained-core limit, with comparable front, oblique and close views and visible debris. Verify the damage shape before spending effort on the full runtime matrix.
Keep the permanent visible blocking core and no-collapse constraint. Candidate depth and fragment sizes may be retuned and must be recorded; reference appearance is not approval of numeric tuning.
Keep Candidate01 assets and evidence immutable; use separate Candidate02 assets and source recipe. Preserve a source/map snapshot before shared task code or the lab map changes.
retained_authority: EnvironmentDestruction01-ED02Start01 remains the start, runtime and ED-02-only independent-review waiver. One Multica production worker, executor self-checks and bounded controller acceptance; owner visual/play acceptance remains separate. No successor dispatch, new paid services or original/shared asset edits.
acceptance_status: Candidate01 rejected. Candidate02 correction authorized within the existing ED-02 scope; no Candidate02 visual approval or technical delivery is claimed.
